{{Quote|The reason for the war was plasma, and the Houses that contributed most to funding the mercenary army were House Tapalo and House Veruna.|[[Cosinga Palpatine]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''House Veruna''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] family that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. According to [[Cosinga Palpatine]], in about [[135 BBY/Legends|135 BBY]], House Veruna and [[House Tapalo]] conspired to hire a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to attack Naboo's native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], as part of a ploy to gain access to Naboo's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] resources. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] of House Veruna was elected as Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]].
